sentences.text: Hawaii Five-0 is an American action police procedural television series , which premiered on Monday , September 20 , 2010 on CBS .	CBS	CBS	action	action film	police procedural	police procedural	Hawaii	Hawaii
The series is a reboot of the original series , which aired on CBS from 1968 to 1980 .	CBS	CBS	reboot	Reboot (fiction)	original series	Hawaii Five-O
